description_en: Retrieves a list of authorized database accounts
description_zh: 获取已授权的数据库账户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-database-accounts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-2r42t9cvf0i --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationDatabaseAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758856.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758856.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page for a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. The default number of entries returned per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default. Do not leave the PageSize parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account. Exact match
parameters.help_zh: 数据库账号名称。精确匹配
parameters.name: database_account_name

DatabaseAccounts.description_zh: 查询到的数据库账户列表

DBName.description_en: The name of the PostgreSQL or Oracle database

DatabaseAccountId.description_en: The ID of the database account

DatabaseAccountName.description_en: The name of the database account

HasPassword.description_en: Indicates whether a password is set for the database host account
HasPassword.description_zh: 数据库主机账户是否设置密码

LoginAttribute.description_en:
The logon attribute. This parameter has a return value only for Oracle databases. Valid values:

SERVICENAME
SID
LoginAttribute.description_zh:
登录属性，Oracle类型数据库有返回值：

SERVICENAME
SID

ProtocolName.description_en: The protocol name of the database account
ProtocolName.description_zh: 数据库账户的协议名称

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of queried manageable database accounts
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的可运维数据库账户总数量
